market_question: Will Mirra Andreeva win the 2026 Women’s French Open?
reasoning: Mirra Andreeva has already demonstrated elite clay-court ability with a French Open semifinal run at age 17 and recently beat world No. 1 Iga Swiatek en route to a WTA 1000 title. By 2026, she will be 19 and likely even stronger, giving her a substantive (though still uncertain) chance to win the French Open. The market's 6.9% implied probability underestimates her odds, which I estimate around 11%.
evidence_points: Andreeva reached the 2024 French Open semifinals, beating Aryna Sabalenka along the way.
She won the 2025 Dubai Duty Free Tennis Championships, defeating Iga Swiatek (world No.1) in the final.
At 17, she is the youngest player in the top 20 and her trajectory suggests continued improvement by 2026.
Clay is her best surface, and the French Open is the most likely Grand Slam for her breakthrough.
